review.identity: Around-sixty male salvage craftsman, lean face and worn temples, gray wavy hair, broad gray beard/mustache, long blunt nose, ochre shirt and dark leather apron edge. Never a foreman, soldier or con artist.
review.v1: Initial redraw read mature face but raw gray curls clipped both side edges. Neck and shoulder-collar region too tall. Heavy black brow/eye mass read anger.
review.v2: Actual raw and 1x/8x inspected. Complete compact hair outline now has positive side margins; no script reconstruction. Beard larger vertically, neck nearly hidden, collar reduced to a narrow lower edge. Same nose/face and gray beard identity held.
review.remaining: Some heavy inward brow, small pale sclera and fine beard texture remain. MEDIANCUT maps scarce ochre collar toward brown; raw collar is clearly ochre. Beard not fully reduced to only a few masses. Narrow raw right margin 11px.
review.acceptance: Awaiting independent review; no native-pixel or runtime approval.

technical_method: Whole-canvas aspect-preserving NN, alpha threshold 128, MEDIANCUT <=32 colors without dither; no scripted facial, hair, clothes or geometry repainting.
